entities.name: Nemesis
entities.description: The nineteenth Magic expansion, released February 2000 as the second set in the Masques block, set on Rath as the Phyrexians prepare to invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane where the Nemesis story takes place, under Phyrexian tyranny.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Phyrexians prepare to invade.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A bloodthirsty noble chosen by Phyrexia to replace Volrath, the main antagonist of the Rath story, who must still prove his worth.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Rath's Evincar, who has abandoned his post.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker, the only one standing in the Dark Lord's way.

entities.name: The Dark Lord
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader whose invasion plans are almost complete.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader in whose name Rath's rebels have united.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force that tyrannizes Rath and chose Crovax.

entities.name: Rath's rebels
entities.description: Rebels united under Eladamri to break free of Phyrexia.

events.summary: Volrath abandoned his post as Evincar, sparking a brutal contest among would-be successors.
events.quote: Rath 's Evincar Volrath has abandoned his post, sparking a brutal contest among his would-be successors.

events.summary: Phyrexia chose Crovax to take Volrath's place and bestowed new powers on him.
events.quote: Phyrexia has chosen Crovax to take Volrath's place

events.summary: Rath's rebels united in Eladamri's name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.
events.quote: Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri , Lord of Leaves, to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny once and for all.

relations.note: Chosen by Phyrexia to replace Volrath.
relations.quote: Phyrexia has chosen Crovax to take Volrath's place

relations.note: Only Urza stands in his way.
relations.quote: Only the Planeswalker Urza stands in his way.
Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri
